answer: Require each agent to post a refundable bond, locked for a full epoch, before its attestations carry weight; a sybil swarm then costs one bond per identity, not one per operator. Weight each attestation by bond-age, so a freshly forked identity carries almost no signal until its capital has sat at risk. Stamp every bond with a one-time pigment: a non-transferable on-chain marker that cannot be recycled across identities. That turns cheap sybil minting from a costless fable into a linear capital expense.
